# airdrop_runneridtokenclaim (Ephemeral Resource)

Claims an ID token of a RunnerIDToken. Unlike the `airdrop_runneridtokenclaim` data source, the token is not stored in the plan or state. Use it in a provider configuration, for example as a Kubernetes API token or an AWS web identity token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "airdrop_runneridtokenclaim" "eks" {
  metadata {
    namespace = "default"
    name      = "eks"
  }
}

# The token is not stored in the plan or state.
provider "kubernetes" {
  host                   = "https://example.eks.amazonaws.com"
  cluster_ca_certificate = base64decode("...")
  token                  = ephemeral.airdrop_runneridtokenclaim.eks.data.id_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `metadata` (Block List) Metadata of the RunnerIDToken to claim. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata))

### Read-Only

- `data` (Object, Sensitive) Claimed data of the RunnerIDToken. `id_token` is the signed ID token. Its `aud` is the RunnerIDToken audience and it expires in an hour. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedblock--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the RunnerIDToken.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the RunnerIDToken.


<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `id_token` (String)
